3. The chorus borrows from the original. The lines beginning with “Never gonna be defeated” closely reproduce the actual song's hook, with minor alterations. 
4. The arrangement is wrong. The actual track features seven verses across multiple performers and two chorus sections. §C reduced that to three verses and repeated the chorus three times. 
5. Very little technical rap craftsmanship. Almost no sustained multisyllabic rhyme chains, internal rhyme development, cadence transitions, or distinct rhythmic identities between verses.
6. The source influenced the names more than the composition. §C recognized several performers, but didn't meaningfully translate the reference's structure and flow into an original composition.
